rule.statement: A vendor's right to repurchase land sold in writing according to the Kandyan provinces' proclamation of 1820 is final and conclusive unless an express stipulation reserving such privilege is inserted in the deed of sale.
rule.supporting_quote: This was done with the object of giving purchaser an immediate and permanent interest in the property and inducing him to improve it.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: proclamation dated eighth day of October 1820
